description: This file defines a custom Android View class named InputView, which extends FrameLayout. It overrides the onMeasure method to customize its measurement behavior, including an optional expansion to fill the entire window, and provides a method to get the inset from the measured height.

classes.name: InputView
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout that measures its content and optionally expands to fill the window, with a method to calculate top insets.

methods.name: InputView(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InputView with context and attribute set.

methods.name: onMeasure(int, int)
methods.description: Overrides the default measurement to implement custom sizing logic based on the EXPAND_TO_WINDOW flag.

methods.name: getTopInsets()
methods.description: Returns the difference between the measured height and the original real height, useful for inset calculations.
